name: ALIEN ATTACK 👽
desc:
ALIEN ATTACK! Milk-crazed aliens want your cow. Don’t let them steal it!
An invasion is underway. Harvest resources, fortify your farm, and repel the horde before they break through.

[7/2/26]
• Maps updated with new decor & alien pathing!
• New lobby! Check out the black market!
• Turret/invisible alien bugs FIXED
• July 4th Weekend: 2x Nickel Event starting 7/3! 

🌾 Gather materials to upgrade your base
🔧 Build powerful weapons and wage war!
🐄 Protect your cow.
👽 More aliens attack every night...
🤝 Team up with friends or stand alone... if you can!

📱 Playable on PC, Mobile, Console and Tablet.
⚠️ Found a bug? Report it in our community to tell the developers!
